rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for a part or section of something.

example.english: This segment of the content is explained very clearly.
example.traditional: 呢部分內容講得好清楚。
example.jyutping: ne1 bou6 fan6 noi6 jung4 gong2 dak1 hou2 cing1 co2

rows.note: Use this for a length or section cut from a continuous object, and sometimes for a linear section of a larger whole.

example.english: This segment of wire is too short to connect.
example.jyutping: ne1 dyun6 din6 sin3 taai3 dyun2 bok3 m4 dou3

rows.note: Use this specifically for a distinct feature or section within a television or radio programme.

example.english: The next segment will feature an interview with a firefighter.
example.traditional: 下一個環節會訪問一位消防員。
example.jyutping: haa6 jat1 go3 waan4 zit3 wui5 fong2 man6 jat1 wai6 siu1 fong4 jyun4
